ox.services.faq_1_a: A written question is free and a branch visit is free. The 20-minute video consultation has a price shown on its own page.
ox.services.faq_2_q: What should I bring to the call or the visit?
ox.services.faq_2_a: Your goal, how many days a week you train, the products you use now, and your question. If the visit is to collect an order, take the order number with you.
ox.services.faq_3_q: Do I have to buy after I ask?
ox.services.faq_3_a: No. Ask, take the answer and decide later. A question commits you to no purchase.
ox.services.faq_4_a: No. We help you understand the products, how to use them and how to read the label. For medical conditions or medication questions, consult your doctor.

ox.pages.about.lead: OptimalX is a supplement and sports nutrition store that started in Madinah, with one branch in Al Khalidiyah on Jabbar bin Sakhr Street, and we ship to every city in Saudi Arabia.
ox.pages.about.story_1: Performance does not start with a supplement. It starts with understanding what you need.
ox.pages.about.story_2: We are two training partners, and we train like you do.
ox.pages.about.story_3: We bought supplements before, then found out we never needed them. Products passed through our hands that looked the same, with no clear difference between them.
ox.pages.about.story_4: With so many choices, our question became simpler:
ox.pages.about.story_7: We did not want to be just another supplement shop. We wanted a place that helps you choose by your goal: a selected range, training programmes, nutrition content, and recommendations and subscriptions built around your need.
ox.pages.about.how_1: We keep a small range we know, understand in detail and can explain.
ox.pages.about.how_2: We describe the product and how it is used, and we explain what the numbers on the label mean, so you know exactly what you are buying.
ox.pages.about.how_3: We help you choose your supplement, recommend what fits your goal, and offer advice, consultations and subscriptions that support that goal.
ox.pages.about.how_line_2: And if you do not need a product, you have the right to know that before you pay for it.
ox.pages.about.how_line_3: We do not want our relationship with you to end at the first order.
ox.pages.about.how_line_4: We want to be the partner who helps you choose, recommends what fits your goal, and sets up a subscription that suits your need over time.
ox.pages.about.how_line_5: OptimalX is at its beginning, and we will not invent ratings or numbers we do not have.
ox.pages.about.own_title: What we have today is clear:
ox.pages.about.own_5: And time set aside for you.
ox.pages.about.closing: What you need, and nothing more.
ox.pages.about.why_1_body: We show you the serving count, the serving size and the expiry date, and help you read the numbers that matter on the label.
ox.pages.about.why_2_body: We do not add a product just because it is trending. We choose products we know, and we can explain the difference between them.
ox.pages.about.why_3_body: We do not diagnose and we do not promise results. We help you choose a supplement and understand how to use it.
ox.pages.about.why_4_body: We started in Al Khalidiyah with one branch and a small team. We ship to every city in Saudi Arabia.

ox.services.nutrition.title: Nutrition and supplements: where to start
ox.services.nutrition.subline: We help you choose a supplement that fits your current routine and understand how to use it.
ox.services.nutrition.intro: A supplement completes your food; it does not replace it. In the consultation we go through your goal, how many days a week you train, your budget and your current routine, then help you see which products come first for you. Nothing complicated, and no buying things you do not need.
